_about: Known problem mods and log messages, from the Cyberpunk 2077 modding wiki's troubleshooting pages (wiki.redmodding.org, for-mod-users/user-guide-troubleshooting, January 2026). Edit this file to add entries; no code change is needed. Paths are game-relative and matched without regard to case.

rules.title: cybercmd is installed together with RED4ext
rules.explanation: RED4ext has done cybercmd's job since version 1.13 (May 2023). The two can't be used together and can stop the game from starting.

rules.title: CTD Helper is installed
rules.explanation: This mod has been broken for a long time and doesn't work with the current game.

rules.title: NPCs Gone Wild is installed
rules.explanation: Since game version 2.0 this mod causes missing characters, missing body parts and exploding limbs.

rules.title: System-Ex is installed
rules.explanation: System-Ex is no longer available and is badly outdated. Cyberware-Ex replaced it.
rules.fix: Uninstall System-Ex and use Cyberware-Ex (Nexus mod 9429) instead.

rules.title: Respector is installed
rules.explanation: Respector is no longer available and is badly outdated. It still causes problems for people who have it.

rules.title: The old Material and Texture Override is installed
rules.explanation: The old version of this mod is known to crash the game in Japantown. Most mods only list it as optional.
rules.fix: If you crash during play, remove it. If a mod really needs it, use the updated version (Nexus mod 25246).

rules.title: Two body frameworks are installed (KSUV and VTK)
rules.explanation: Only one body framework can work at a time. Having both causes grey skin, clipping and missing body parts.
rules.fix: Keep either KSUV or VTK, not both, and use clothing refits made for that one.

rules.title: Two versions of Virtual Atelier are installed
rules.explanation: Both the old virtual-atelier and the new virtual-atelier-full script folders exist. This breaks script compilation for every Atelier store.
rules.fix: Remove every Virtual Atelier file, then install the newest version once.

rules.title: A modlist.txt file changes your archive load order
rules.explanation: When archive/pc/mod/modlist.txt exists, the game loads .archive mods in the order that file lists instead of by name. That makes conflicts hard to predict, and the wiki advises against it.
rules.fix: Delete archive/pc/mod/modlist.txt unless you created it on purpose.

rules.title: ReShade or OptiScaler files are in the game folder
rules.explanation: Frame generation, DLSS/FSR replacements and ReShade are a common cause of crashes and of the game not starting.
rules.fix: Remove them while you troubleshoot. Put them back once the game works.

rules.title: You have a very large number of mods
rules.explanation: With more than about 460 mods the game can crash because of its analytics feature.
rules.fix: In the game's settings, turn off Enable Analytics.

rules.title: A script mod seems to be installed twice
rules.explanation: The script compiler reported that a mod adds a field that already exists. That usually means the same script mod is in two folders, often after its author renamed the folder.
rules.fix: Remove both copies and install the latest version once.

all.log_contains: field with this name is already defined

explain.meaning: The game tried to read memory it couldn't. This usually means a broken mod file.
explain.fix: Find the broken mod by turning off half your mods at a time.

explain.meaning: The game tried to read memory it couldn't. This usually means a broken mod file.
explain.fix: Find the broken mod by turning off half your mods at a time.

explain.meaning: Something made the game ask for more memory than it can use, usually a mod.
explain.fix: Find the broken mod by turning off half your mods at a time.

explain.meaning: The graphics card driver crashed. This is rarely a script mod; graphics mods, overclocks and drivers are more likely.
explain.fix: Turn off graphics mods and check your GPU driver.

explain.meaning: The game took too long to load something and stopped itself.
explain.fix: Make sure the game is on an SSD. If it happens with mods only, find the mod by turning off half at a time.

explain.contains: ensure your game is updated to patch
explain.meaning: This RED4ext is newer than your game.

explain.contains: could not attach the hook for the main function
explain.meaning: RED4ext couldn't hook into the game, usually because the game or a framework is out of date.
explain.fix: Update the game and all six core frameworks.

explain.contains: failed to resolve address for hash
explain.meaning: A framework doesn't match your game version.
explain.fix: Update the game and the core frameworks (RED4ext, ArchiveXL, TweakXL, Codeware, redscript, CET).

explain.meaning: The compiled script cache is out of date or broken.
explain.fix: Delete the r6/cache folder, verify the game files in your launcher, then reinstall redscript.

explain.meaning: One of your .archive mods is broken.
explain.fix: Find it by turning off half of your archive mods at a time.

explain.meaning: The game's own script files are missing or changed.
explain.fix: Verify the game files in your launcher.

explain.meaning: The game's TweakDB cache is missing or out of date.
explain.fix: Copy r6/cache/tweakdb.bin (and tweakdb_ep1.bin if you have Phantom Liberty) into r6/cache/modded.

explain.meaning: One or more script mods don't compile, so none of the script mods load.
explain.fix: Check the script errors below. Mods listed there may be outdated or missing a requirement.

explain.meaning: A script mod uses something that doesn't exist, usually because a requirement is missing or the mod is outdated.
explain.fix: Install the mod's requirements, or update the mod.

explain.contains: this method replacement overwrites a previous annotation
explain.meaning: Two script mods replace the same game function; only one of them works.
explain.fix: Keep one of the two mods, or look for a compatibility patch.

explain.meaning: This RED4ext plugin was built for a different game version.
explain.fix: Update the mod that ships this plugin, or remove it until it's updated.
